senses.gloss: (contr. of טאב) = h. טוֹב, to be good, well.—טב ל־ to feel well, be satisfied, fare well.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 15:16">Targ. Deut. XV, 16</cite>; a. e.
